shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, wide overhead composition placing the ice castle suspended above the volcanic crater’s churning lava. Foreground: misty cold air; background: flowing lava arcs forming natural leading lines. Watercolor edges show slight bleeding. Ice body is wrapped in cool light, its base gently lifted by warm orange reflection. No character is highlighted—only the grand contrast between castle and lava. Camera slowly pushes forward.
shot2: Shot 2 connects with previous shot via hard cut. Full shot, eye-level, focusing on an anime-style girl walking from one end of the ice bridge toward the domed greenhouse. Crystal textures on the bridge and lava below create depth perspective. Castle silhouette remains visible in background. Lighting continues dual cool-warm tone. The girl is lit with soft rim light; her dress flutters slightly from heat and cold fog. Camera side-tracks smoothly to follow.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions from previous shot via match-action. Medium overhead shot entering the greenhouse interior. Foreground: translucent ice branches; background: softly blurred dome ceiling. The girl places a clear seed into the center of a frost-covered ice pot. Composition uses the pot’s edge as a circular frame. Cool diffuse light highlights fingers and seed clarity; warm reflection glimmers subtly along the rim. the faint Camera slowly tilts down and gently pushes in.
shot4: Shot 4 connects with previous shot via hard cut. Close-up, eye-level, shifting focus to the edge of the pot and spout. Foreground: sharp water droplets; background: softly blurred girl’s face. Melted snowwater is poured slowly, transparent stream passing through intersecting cool and warm light beams onto the soil. Particles in the pot gradually moisten and darken—physical change clearly visible. Water Camera makes slight tilt to follow the falling stream.
shot5: Shot 5 connects with previous shot via dissolve. Close-up overhead focusing on the soil surface. Tight composition; shallow depth of field blurs edge frost into soft bokeh. Moistened soil begins to ripple and vibrate gently; small ice fragments are pushed aside. Main light remains cool blue diffusion; localized warm reflection seeps through cracks. Camera nearly static, only a minimal push-in to emphasize change.
shot6: Shot 6 connects with previous shot via hard cut. Close-up, eye-level, focused on cracked soil. A tender sprout emerges, pushing through wet soil. Foreground: out-of-focus pot edge creates framing; background: pale ice dome. Sprout surface glistens with moisture and tiny soil particles. Movement from breaking through to straightening is fluid.
shot7: Shot 7 connects with previous shot via soft dissolve. Medium close-up, eye-level, showing the sprout rapidly growing taller, leaves unfolding one by one. Veins glow under backlight through semi-transparent texture. Foreground: blurred ice branches form natural framing; background: girl stands behind the pot, quietly observing. Layering is richer. Cool-warm lighting remains consistent but brightness increases slightly to convey vitality. Camera performs a small arc around the subject.
shot8: Shot 8 connects with previous shot via hard cut. Wide low-angle shot including both plant and ice crystal support. Dome’s curved structure in background enhances ascent. Warm lava reflection gently lifts from below; cool blue ambient light falls from above. Frame is stable yet conveys growth momentum. Camera tilts upward from bottom to follow stem rise.
shot9: Shot 9 connects with previous shot via match-shape transition. Close-up backlight focusing on the bud. Foreground: few blurred ice threads; background: washed into soft haze by dome light. Bud surface swells from closed to taut, faint warm glow visible inside. Tiny vapor floats at edges. Camera moves in at extreme slow speed.
shot10: Shot 10 connects with previous shot via hard cut. Medium eye-level shot returns to the girl, leaning forward to watch the bud, hands gently resting on the pot edge. Facial expression is gentle and focused. Composition places her on one side, bud on the other, establishing a protective relationship. Cool light defines cheek contours; warm light reflects subtly in eyes and lips.
shot11: Close-up low-angle directly facing the flower’s blooming climax. Petals burst open layer by layer, translucent pollen dispersing like fine stardust, yet retaining plant texture and realistic growth logic. Pollen drifts across foreground; girl in background softened into light silhouette. Under cool blue main light, the flower center emits warm white glow. Camera first quickly micro-pushes, then immediately stabilizes, creating impact before the climax freeze-frame.
shot12: Shot 12 connects with previous shot via fade-out then fade-in. Wide overhead view re-establishes the central dome greenhouse in the ice castle. A new flower glows quietly at the core, its halo piercing the dome and illuminating surrounding ice walls and lower lava, forming a final composition of contrasting cool and warm tones. The girl becomes a quiet small silhouette beside the flower. The entire castle is softened into a picture-book-like ending with watercolor texture. Camera slowly pulls back and holds on a wide shot.
